name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Crane, Cellar, and Valet belong to different suspects.
Crane does not go with Butler.
Either Crane goes with Kitchen, or Grimsby goes with Gardener — but not both.
Crane, Study, and Doctor belong to different suspects.
Either Cellar goes with Valet, or Library goes with Gardener — but not both.
Between Butler and Valet, one goes with Kitchen and the other with Study.
Blackwood, Kitchen, and Doctor belong to different suspects.
Either Cellar goes with Blackwood or Butler goes with Holloway.
